assessment_kind: Editorial evidence triage, committed-source identity checks, and separately recorded bounded software qualification
coverage: All 161 selected imported components: 90 primary and 71 supporting records. Prior scientific assessments are retained for the remaining components; the current inventory excludes the ARC-AGI-2 experiment and its four supporting collections, removed on 30 October 2026.

scoped_release: The release record marks the stated mathematical or executable requirements as complete. The scope below defines what is covered.
reading_release: The stated manuscript or reader set is released. Formal coverage, review depth and wider research can remain incomplete.
development: A candidate, working manuscript or bounded research milestone with identified unfinished work.
prototype: A research instrument, implementation or experiment whose tested scope does not establish a general scientific endpoint.
unassessed: Available material lacks a sufficient assessed source/status record for a stronger label.
earlier_checkpoint: An earlier edition kept with its own evidence. Later acceptance records do not change that evidence.
supporting: Preserved sources and earlier editions. Availability alone does not establish scientific completion.
reader_available: The PDF edition and reading scope have been identified. Matching editable sources, full page review, and reproducible build qualification remain pending.

contract: The cited release explicitly reports completion of its registered formal contract, under its exact hypotheses.
partial: Compiler/replay evidence is reported for a subset or bounded block. No whole-work coverage is implied.
inherited: The edition relies on earlier or related formal evidence. That evidence is not a fresh full-edition replay.
source: Lean text is present, but the assessed edition has no accepted current compiler pass.
none: The assessed scope claims writing, calculations or experiments rather than Lean verification.

formal: Strong evidence for the exact checked subset, conditional on correct formal statements, source correspondence, dependencies and recorded execution.
historical: Earlier/related formal records support their own scope. Current-edition replay or expanded coverage may be missing.
reviewed: The cited edition records a scoped written review and/or proof audit with its stated depth. Finite checks support only their tested claims.
author: Written / finite evidence
Written arguments, author review or bounded computations. These records do not establish independent review or formal assurance.
experimental: Confidence is limited to the stated experiment, fixture, prototype or engineering tests. Generalization and scientific endpoints remain separate.
unassessed: There is not enough assessed evidence for a confidence classification.
